title: Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool
architecture: 32 actual 8 x 10-inch PDF pages, including cover and illustrated back; story pages2-31.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line:
Rumi's undersea adventure
A little voice. A whole city listening.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The castle's candle was still missing. But Rumi's pool shimmered, and its rainbow kept turning.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: What if nobody hears me?

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: Then I will. Come to our evening song.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: She held out her hand.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Down they swam, through the shining oval beneath the pool. A whole city glowed below.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Curved roofs. Peach windows. Seaweed gardens.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: We're still in the castle?

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: Every bit. Even the bubble tram!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: A bubble tram glided over the pearl bridge. Roshan started after its sparkling bubbles.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: Wait. Our way is underneath.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: Watch that leaf. It shows where the water goes.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan watched it curl around the pillar.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: She slowed her tail, followed the curve and slipped through the clear arch.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: The water helped me!

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: I'm Duri. These bells are for tonight's song. That banner goes to the stage.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: One bell drifted into the kelp. Roshan followed the curling water and caught it gently.

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: Thank you! I'll meet you at the music room after this delivery.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: His little bell went ding, ding, ding.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Rumi led Roshan to the music room. Two friends were waiting under its curved roof.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: I'm Hana. I dance BIG!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Her copper hair floated behind her.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: I'm Nari. I hear tiny things.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: I'm Roshan. I'm glad to be here.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: Try a note with us.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Mine might be very little.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: That is a lovely place to start.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Hana spread her arms for a BIG dance. A ribbon brushed Nari's hair.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: Room for one small drummer, please!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Hana made a smaller turn. Roshan copied her and tried a tiny note.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: I heard that.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan smiled.

text.speaker: Trio
text.line:
Little voice, big blue sea.
Sing with you, sing with me.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Usually, the shops answered, then the bathhouse, then the tram. Tonight there was no answer.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Where is everybody?

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Between the last notes, she heard something very small.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Hana drew a breath to sing louder. Roshan raised one hand.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Wait.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Tap. Tap. Tap.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: A bell?

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: No. Someone knocking. Down there.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The friends held still. This time, everyone heard it. They followed Roshan out of the music room.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The tapping led below the tram bridge. Two arches opened beside the pillar.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: Which way?

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Let's listen again.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: The tapping is behind those fronds.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Hana waited for the little sound.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Rumi held the soft kelp aside. Roshan swam through the clear space. A warm lantern shone ahead.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Two concert crates pressed close together. Duri was caught between them, with a soft banner snagged at his shell.

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: The crates blocked my delivery. I tried to move them. Then they slid.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: We're here now. We'll make you a space.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan floated beside Duri. His tapping had become very quiet.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Don't pull. We're going to look first.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Hana began to push a crate. The cloth tugged. Everyone stopped.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: The banner is still caught!

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: I can lift this loop first.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Then I'll move the crate.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: Tell me when. I'll hold the other one.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Rumi slipped the cloth over Duri's shell. Roshan braced both hands on the crate.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: One. Two. Gently.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan pushed sideways. Hana steadied the other crate. A little space opened.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Can you move your flippers?

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: One flipper. Two flippers. Duri paddled free and touched Roshan's hand.

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: You heard me!

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: You kept tapping.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Rumi caught his drifting courier basket. The bells were safe, and so was Duri.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: No more carrying that alone today.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Nari tapped the crate. Duri tapped back. Tap. Tap. Tap.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: Now let's find you somewhere cozy.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The warm-current bathhouse was quiet. The friends could finally rest.

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: I kept tapping. But everything was so loud.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: My voice feels little too.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: Are we singers or sea bunnies?

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Nari's towel had funny ears. Duri untucked his flippers. Roshan laughed beside him.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: They settled on a cream couch. Hana spread out her long fin.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: I dance BIG. I rest BIG too.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: Room for one small turtle, please.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Hana folded her fin. Duri nestled between them.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line:
Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: They hummed softly and shared seaweed snacks.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: A top hat bobbed through the curtain. POOF! Rumi drew Duri close.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: That wasn't our song.

text.speaker: Magician Imp
text.line: Our enormous show! Only our voices!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The performer imp flourished a sparkling banner. Duri paddled up.

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: Your show crates blocked my delivery.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Let's see where they put them.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The imps hurried towards the stage. The friends followed.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Beneath the stage, three crates crowded a golden current arch. The hanging ribbons barely moved.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: The magic is here. But the song can't travel through.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan spotted a narrow thread of blue water under the lowest crate.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: There is still a way through.

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: I deliver parcels here. I know a way in.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: He led them behind the bridge.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Hana folded her big fin close and took her time.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: Slow tails. Small turns.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Nari listened at each turn. This time she spoke clearly.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: Left here!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan followed. Little things made a useful path.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: That crate can slide sideways.

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: There's a clear ledge for the props. I use it for parcels.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Rumi checked the banner loop. Hana found a place to push. Nari tested the other end.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: Ready when you are.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: We can fix it. First, let's ask.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: They swam up to the shell stage together.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Your crates trapped Duri. And they're blocking the city's song. Will you move them?

text.speaker: Performer Imp
text.line: Our show needs enormous props!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: He puffed out his glittery jacket.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: It needs neighbours too. There's room for your show and everyone else's voices.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The farthest terraces stayed quiet.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: We'll put the scenery safely at the side.

text.speaker: Magician Imp
text.line: Nobody touches our spectacular scenery!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: POOF! Bubbles poured between Roshan and the gate. She paused instead of pushing through.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The performer lifted a soft foam star. Hana caught a corner of the banner.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: Now we need our big moves.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Rumi took the first note. Hana swept into a bright dance. The trio turned together.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: I'll get to the crate!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: She slipped along the stage edge, looking for the current.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Nari tapped the shell drum.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: Keep the beat with me. We'll keep the way clear!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The bubble cloud hid the gate. Roshan stopped and watched the little blue thread of water.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Nari left one drumbeat quiet and listened.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: The water is moving through the bottom!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan ducked beneath the bubbles. Above her, Rumi spun clear of another puff.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: Little voice, big blue sea!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: WHOOSH! Hana caught the foam star in the soft banner. Nari bounced it gently back.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: Your star, coming home!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The performer tumbled onto his padded cushions.

text.speaker: Performer Imp
text.line: Oof! A very soft landing!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The magician's next puff spun his hat backwards. BUMP! He landed beside his friend.

text.speaker: Hana
text.line: Big moves. Soft finish.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Rumi and Nari slid the two small crates onto the side ledge. Hana steadied them. One large crate remained.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan looped the banner through its handle. She pulled. The crate moved a little, then stopped.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: I need you!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Duri checked the clear space. Her friends came to take their places.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Hana, push. Rumi, with me. Nari, count.

text.speaker: Nari
text.line: One. Two. Gently!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The last crate slid clear.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Duri swam through the open arch. A bright blue ribbon of current curled after him. All three crates stayed at the side.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: There!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The ribbons stirred above the stage. The magic had been there all along.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The current reached the shops. Duri tapped at a window. One little voice answered. Then another.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: He hurried past the bathhouse. Its neighbours hummed the familiar tune. The bridge ribbons fluttered.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: At the tram, more voices joined in. Duri's delivery was a song this time.

text.speaker: Duri
text.line: Everyone, there's room for you!

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: The imps moved their scenery into tidy stacks, leaving the current clear.

text.speaker: Performer Imp
text.line: Nobody sang with our show.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: You blocked their song.

text.speaker: Magician Imp
text.line: We didn't mean to trap you, Duri. Can we help now?

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: Leave everyone a space.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Rumi, Hana and Nari sang. Roshan joined them. The city answered, from the shops to the tram.

text.speaker: Everyone
text.line:
Little voice, big blue sea.
Sing with you, sing with me.

text.speaker: Everyone
text.line:
Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Roshan heard every voice.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: At last, Roshan and Rumi swam home. The seahorse fountain splashed, and the familiar rainbow turned.

text.speaker: Roshan
text.line: We haven't found the candle yet.

text.speaker: Rumi
text.line: No. But today, you heard a friend.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line: Far below came a little goodnight. Tap. Tap. Tap.

text.speaker: Narrator
text.line:
A little voice.
A whole city listening.

Tap. Tap. Tap.

iteration: Owner-directed bathhouse recovery, couch downtime and imp interruption; pages15-17 revised. Existing sources preserved.
